candidate_state: release candidate validated from the release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book feature, release and trainer Python tests, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly native tests, release package generation, and generated JavaScript contract checks passed. QS_STYLE=1 was selected by paired material-only gates at one and four search threads and was directionally positive in capped self-play checks with the in-house nn_pool HalfKP network. This release does not adopt a new checkpoint or make a general playing-strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.65.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The nn_pool checks of QS_STYLE=1 were positive at one and four threads but reached their game caps before the preregistered SPRT acceptance boundary.
IncrementUsePercent remains at 0 because its four-thread material-only confirmation was neutral.
CORR_W_NP remains at its prior default because its in-house NNUE four-thread confirmation was stopped after 48 games without a verdict.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
